# StrStrUsedAsStrPos

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `StrStrUsedAsStrPosInspection`

`strstr()` / `stristr()` build and return a substring. When the result is only
used as a yes/no answer ("does the haystack contain the needle?"), that copy is
wasted work: a position search (`strpos()` / `stripos()`) compared strictly
against `false` answers the same question without allocating.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,8,9} [Before]
<?php
function scan($text, $word, $flag) {
    if (strstr($text, $word)) {}
    if (!stristr($text, '#')) {}
    while ($flag and strstr($text, $word)) { $flag = false; }
    $a = strstr($text, $word) ? 1 : 2;
    $b = !(strstr($text, $word));
    $c = FALSE == \strstr($text, $word, true);
    $d = stristr($text, $word) != false;

    $e = strstr($text, $word);
    $f = true == strstr($text, $word);
    $g = (strstr($text, $word)) === false;
    $h = strstr($text, $word) ?: 'none';
    $i = strstr($text);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function scan($text, $word, $flag) {
    if (strpos($text, $word) !== false) {}
    if (stripos($text, '#') === false) {}
    while ($flag and strpos($text, $word) !== false) { $flag = false; }
    $a = strpos($text, $word) !== false ? 1 : 2;
    $b = !(strpos($text, $word) !== false);
    $c = \strpos($text, $word) === false;
    $d = stripos($text, $word) !== false;

    $e = strstr($text, $word);
    $f = true == strstr($text, $word);
    $g = (strstr($text, $word)) === false;
    $h = strstr($text, $word) ?: 'none';
    $i = strstr($text);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;strpos($text, $word) !== false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;stripos($text, &#39;#&#39;) === false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;strpos($text, $word) !== false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;strpos($text, $word) !== false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;strpos($text, $word) !== false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 8: Use &#39;\strpos($text, $word) === false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
<li>line 9: Use &#39;stripos($text, $word) !== false&#39; instead; it avoids building a substring.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | | | Operand order in the fix follows the global comparison style (`regular` default / `yoda`). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StrStrUsedAsStrPos": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StrStrUsedAsStrPos

/**
 * @noinspection StrStrUsedAsStrPosInspection
 */
```
